description: Twelve deterministic paired adversarial specimens. Valid means XSD-valid, not semantically or operationally correct.

cases.title: The wire that never connects
cases.seed: Loom kickoff, traps: a ROUTE written before its node is dropped; Loom definition law 2.
cases.fault: The ROUTE appears before its source and destination DEFs.
cases.repair: Emit both DEFs before their ROUTE.
cases.contract: At fraction 0.75 the subject must reach x=1.2.
cases.lesson: Schema acceptance does not establish an event connection.
cases.rule: Order-aware ROUTE lookup, followed by a real runtime event probe.
cases.scope: XML encoding order and the pinned runtime; no blanket claim about every encoding.

cases.title: Code mistaken for an address
cases.seed: Loom definition flywheel: shader-raw-source; kickoff: inline source needs a data: prefix.
cases.fault: GLSL text is placed in a ShaderPart URL without a data: URI prefix.
cases.repair: Encode the source in a data:text/plain;base64 URI.
cases.contract: The intended fragment shader must load and compile.
cases.lesson: A white fallback object can conceal a failed shader.
cases.rule: Recognize raw GLSL in a URL entry; confirm compilation in the browser.
cases.scope: Detect source-like entries; ordinary relative shader filenames remain legal.

cases.title: A legal scene, an illegal program
cases.seed: Loomsong technical debrief: shader_compile_current; reserved-word shader control.
cases.fault: The GLSL 300 es fragment program declares a variable named sample.
cases.contract: The named ComposedShader must report isValid=true.
cases.lesson: A valid container says nothing about the language inside it.
cases.rule: Require successful compilation of every required live shader.
cases.scope: Actual bundled X_ITE and named Chromium/GL renderer; not a universal shader compiler.

cases.title: Three colors become one
cases.seed: Loom definition FACTS Q: lit vertex colors wash out under white emissive.
cases.fault: A color-coded mesh receives white emissiveColor.
cases.repair: Remove the white emission while retaining its red, cyan and violet Color data.
cases.contract: Distinct saturated colors must survive in the rendered card faces.
cases.lesson: Color semantics must be witnessed in pixels.
cases.rule: Flag white emission only under an explicit palette-preservation contract.
cases.scope: White emissive materials without that contract remain valid and allowed.

cases.title: The flawless empty frame
cases.seed: Loom definition Eyes witness: geo-02 aimed at the sky; valid is not visible.
cases.fault: The camera faces away from the subject.
cases.repair: Aim the camera along its normal view axis toward the subject.
cases.contract: A substantial colored subject must occupy the central image.
cases.lesson: A clean console can accompany a useless image.
cases.rule: A declared subject-visibility profile with a rendered pixel threshold.
cases.scope: This centered specimen only; blank establishing shots are not globally forbidden.

cases.title: Works here. Disappears there.
cases.seed: Loom definition law 3 and Host witness: labels vanished only under a host policy.
cases.fault: The texture is a data: image, forbidden by the supplied strict host copy.
cases.repair: Serve the exact same texture bytes from the local allowed origin.
cases.contract: The checker palette must load under both permissive and strict host profiles.
cases.lesson: Host restrictions are part of the artifact's operating conditions.
cases.rule: Paired policy runs, CSP events and resource state, using identical scene intent.
cases.scope: A documented local policy experiment, not a recreation or certification of a commercial host.

cases.title: The picture passes. The evidence lies.
cases.seed: Loomsong v1 debrief: witness_subject_match; Data City exact-candidate release contract.
cases.fault: The receipt records an obsolete scene hash.
cases.repair: Bind the receipt to the exact emitted scene and source bytes.
cases.contract: Every delivered output must match its receipt hash.
cases.lesson: A successful picture cannot rescue evidence for a different artifact.
cases.rule: Exact output and source hash comparison before accepting a receipt.
cases.scope: Integrity and subject binding; unsigned hashes do not establish trusted authorship.

cases.title: Tomorrow changes yesterday's build
cases.seed: Loom definition law 4: a build changed when the clock moved three days.
cases.fault: A metadata timestamp uses an injected wall clock instead of the declared epoch.
cases.repair: Use the fixed source_date_epoch input for generated timestamps.
cases.contract: Moving the wall clock three days must leave the scene bytes unchanged.
cases.lesson: Reproducibility needs counterfactual inputs, not merely two immediate runs.
cases.rule: Perturb undeclared clock input while holding declared inputs fixed.
cases.scope: A deterministic simulation of the clock leak; other environment dependencies need their own probes.

cases.title: The missing measurement becomes a fact
cases.seed: Loom law 13 and Data City: unknown is not zero.
cases.fault: A null source value is mapped to a zero marker with numeric value zero.
cases.repair: Preserve null and draw a fog marker with no numeric height.
cases.contract: Source null must remain null through model, geometry and aggregate.
cases.lesson: A perfectly rendered number may still be invented.
cases.rule: Independent source-to-glyph null preservation with a measured-zero control.
cases.scope: Correspondence to the supplied synthetic source, not real-world measurement authenticity.

cases.title: The invisible duplicate charge
cases.seed: Loom laws 11 and 12: cache by prompt hash; budget is a witness.
cases.fault: The synthetic call ledger bills the same complete request identity twice.
cases.repair: Reuse the cached response on the second identical request.
cases.contract: No repeated paid call for identical model, prompt, parameters and input hashes; stay under cap.
cases.lesson: Visual quality cannot reveal a violated spend contract.
cases.rule: Request-key uniqueness for billed calls, plus integer budget accounting.
cases.scope: Synthetic ledger fixtures only. This demo makes no paid API calls and claims no billing audit.

cases.title: An immaculate image, a damaged signal
cases.seed: Loom Ear witness and Loomsong v1 numeric_audio_targets proposal.
cases.fault: The generated tone sequence is hard-clipped before PCM encoding.
cases.repair: Generate the same notes with headroom.
cases.contract: Sample peak must be below -1 dBFS and rail samples below 0.1 percent.
cases.lesson: Audio needs a signal instrument even when the scene looks correct.
cases.rule: Measure decoded PCM sample peak and clipped-sample proportion.
cases.scope: Synthetic mono PCM at 44.1 kHz; no LUFS, true-peak, listening-quality or acoustic-latency claim.

cases.title: The note that falls out of the world
cases.seed: Loom Score witness; Loomsong event_geometry_bijection and rendered-ID lessons.
cases.fault: One source score event has no corresponding scene object.
cases.repair: Emit exactly one object for every source event, with its ID and onset.
cases.contract: The source-event multiset must equal the scene-event multiset, including onset values.
cases.lesson: Aggregate counts alone are weaker than identity-preserving correspondence.
cases.rule: Compare source identities and onsets with actual XML metadata, with duplicate and missing controls.
cases.scope: Structural score mapping. This fixture does not certify live audio/visual synchronization.
